topic: Remove deodorant marks from a dark shirt
core_question: How do I get white deodorant marks off a dark-colored shirt? (secondary: Where and how do I get a duplicate of my house key made?)
answer_summary: Rub the white deodorant residue with a dryer sheet, damp washcloth, or nylon stocking to lift and buff off the antiperspirant buildup before laundering.; after the topic shift: Take the original key to a hardware store, locksmith, or big-box retailer's key-cutting kiosk/counter to have an exact duplicate cut.
